tasks.question: Why does Hy exhibit significantly slower startup performance when installed from wheel distributions compared to source installations, despite including precompiled bytecode?
tasks.reference_answer: Hy registers .hy as a source suffix and overrides SourceFileLoader.source_to_code to compile Hy source when that hook is invoked (hy/importer.py:105-128). The custom setup install command also creates checked-hash bytecode for .hy outputs (setup.py:29-41). These facts do not imply that valid bytecode is ignored or that every import recompiles source. The claimed wheel-specific startup slowdown requires measurements and inspection of installed cache validity; it is not established by this source.
